title: Colonal Hunger
description: Turn your hunger bar into Pink Slime Carrots!
body:
The Colonal Hunger Resource Pack adds Colonals signature Pink Slime Carrots to the Hunger Bar!

It is themed around Colonal's love of Pink Slime, and is optimized for to be used in the [Colonal Mod Pack (CMP)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/colonal-pack).
